description: This file defines handlers for different Slack message subtypes, including message changed, deleted, and thread broadcast events. It provides functions to resolve event details and select appropriate handlers based on event subtype.

classes.name: SlackMessageSubtypeHandler
classes.description: Type defining the structure of a handler for Slack message subtypes, including methods for describing, context key, sender ID, channel ID, and channel type resolution.

methods.name: resolveSlackMessageSubtypeHandler
methods.description: Function that returns the appropriate handler for a given Slack message event based on its subtype.
